title: 银行家算法：安全性检测与请求检测（含回滚）
expected_output:
=== 用例 1：安全状态 ===
Available = [3, 3, 2]
  P0: Max=[7, 5, 3] Allocation=[0, 1, 0] Need=[7, 4, 3]
  P1: Max=[3, 2, 2] Allocation=[2, 0, 0] Need=[1, 2, 2]
  P2: Max=[9, 0, 2] Allocation=[3, 0, 2] Need=[6, 0, 0]
  P3: Max=[2, 2, 2] Allocation=[2, 1, 1] Need=[0, 1, 1]
  P4: Max=[4, 3, 3] Allocation=[0, 0, 2] Need=[4, 3, 1]
是否安全 = True, 安全序列 = ['P1', 'P3', 'P4', 'P0', 'P2'], 最终 Work = [10, 5, 7]

请求检测:
  进程 P1 请求 [1, 0, 2]
  试分配后安全，安全序列 = ['P1', 'P3', 'P4', 'P0', 'P2'] -> 正式分配

=== 用例 2：不安全状态 ===
  P0: Max=[7, 5, 3] Allocation=[0, 1, 0] Need=[7, 4, 3]
  P1: Max=[3, 2, 2] Allocation=[2, 0, 0] Need=[1, 2, 2]
  P2: Max=[9, 0, 2] Allocation=[3, 0, 2] Need=[6, 0, 0]
Available = [0, 2, 0]
是否安全 = False, 能完成的进程 = []

重要: 安全状态一定不会死锁；但不安全状态只是『可能』死锁 —— 这是单向蕴含

code:
def need_matrix(maxm, alloc):
    return [[maxm[i][j] - alloc[i][j] for j in range(len(maxm[0]))] for i in range(len(maxm))]


def is_safe(available, maxm, alloc):
    n = len(maxm)
    m = len(available)
    need = need_matrix(maxm, alloc)
    work = list(available)
    finish = [False] * n
    seq = []
    while len(seq) < n:
        progressed = False
        for i in range(n):
            if not finish[i] and all(need[i][j] <= work[j] for j in range(m)):
                for j in range(m):
                    work[j] += alloc[i][j]
                finish[i] = True
                seq.append(i)
                progressed = True
        if not progressed:
            break
    return all(finish), seq, work


def request(available, maxm, alloc, i, req):
    n, m = len(maxm), len(available)
    need = need_matrix(maxm, alloc)
    print("  进程 P%d 请求 %s" % (i, req))
    if any(req[j] > need[i][j] for j in range(m)):
        print("  拒绝: 请求超过声明的最大需求 Need[P%d]=%s" % (i, need[i]))
        return False
    if any(req[j] > available[j] for j in range(m)):
        print("  等待: 可用资源 Available=%s 不足" % available)
        return False
    # 试分配
    for j in range(m):
        available[j] -= req[j]
        alloc[i][j] += req[j]
    ok, seq, _ = is_safe(available, maxm, alloc)
    if ok:
        print("  试分配后安全，安全序列 = %s -> 正式分配" % ["P%d" % x for x in seq])
        return True
    else:
        for j in range(m):      # 回滚
            available[j] += req[j]
            alloc[i][j] -= req[j]
        print("  试分配后不安全 -> 回滚，让 P%d 等待" % i)
        return False


# ---- 用例 1：安全状态 ----
print("=== 用例 1：安全状态 ===")
available = [3, 3, 2]
maxm = [[7, 5, 3], [3, 2, 2], [9, 0, 2], [2, 2, 2], [4, 3, 3]]
alloc = [[0, 1, 0], [2, 0, 0], [3, 0, 2], [2, 1, 1], [0, 0, 2]]
need = need_matrix(maxm, alloc)
print("Available =", available)
for i in range(len(maxm)):
    print("  P%d: Max=%s Allocation=%s Need=%s" % (i, maxm[i], alloc[i], need[i]))
ok, seq, work = is_safe(available, maxm, alloc)
print("是否安全 = %s, 安全序列 = %s, 最终 Work = %s" % (ok, ["P%d" % x for x in seq], work))
print("")
print("请求检测:")
request(available, maxm, alloc, 1, [1, 0, 2])

# ---- 用例 2：不安全状态 ----
